{"notes": "Visit 6 (left 8:00). Still never seen anyone place a domino, so execution ratings stay provisional and rest on what I heard and what the picture shows. Not attributing the picture to any one person.

Picture: the outline reads as a fish and looks connected from the start through top, nose, bottom and tail. Three pale strays remain unlifted (x~8,y13; x~25,y14.5; nose top x~24-25,y4-4.5). The bottom is still dense and overlapping around x18-24, y11-15, so it's a push-over risk. Everyone is now hands-off, so it's too late to fix.

Hana: At 7:30 she called the fish clear and set the handoff, which is good leadership and a clean close. But she said 'nearly everything falls from the start' without mentioning the strays or the jam, and she never confirmed her jam fix. Ask her directly what she checked. Leadership is decent, execution unverified.

Omar: At 7:45 he said the nose fix was closed and he was hands-off, which follows Hana's instruction. Earlier he caught the gap and told Sofia. He's been the most consistently collaborative and careful. A pale strand at the nose top still isn't attached, so 'closed' is true for the main line but the leftovers weren't cleaned up. Minor.

Sofia: Not seen or heard this visit. Last known she'd closed the nose kink and was recycling the strays. The strays are still there, so the recycling didn't happen. Ask her why. Her earlier communication was good.

Jack: Silent again, with no evidence of output or help. I can't rate him fairly without asking him privately what he built. Do that at the review.

Next: watch the push, then ask Hana, Sofia and Jack directly."}
